main.description: List active LoRA adapters owned by an actor DID. Backed by vertex_lora_adapter on RisingWave (ADR-2605070700 lineage rows). Used by the ameno browser UI to surface per-actor adapter choices; weights are fetched separately from the PDS proxy (lora/{actorDid}/{adapterId}/adapter.safetensors). Server-side, the langserver pod runs SELECT through the same dispatcher path as listHistory.

actorDid.description: Owner DID; required. Filter on vertex_lora_adapter.did.

domain.description: Optional domain filter (e.g. finance, legal, code).

baseModel.description: Engine model id this adapter targets (e.g. gemma-4-e2b-it).

weightB2Uri.description: B2 / R2 URI for the adapter.safetensors blob.

adapterAlpha.description: α scaling factor × 1000 (integer-only per AT lexicon).
